capability: Stamp each version and chain it to the last
title: Every version gets a tick.

hook.picture: Close: two almost identical lines lie side by side; the whale looks from one to the other and back.
hook.words: Was it this one, or that?

problem_in_viewer_words.body: Which version did the client actually see?

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Pull back: lines get redrawn over themselves, in place, leaving no trace of what they were. Three-times device: three silent redraws, every 2 beats, then 1, then half, each wiping the last shape away.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: Edits write over the old one.

stakes.body: You cannot stand behind work you cannot trace, and a silent change becomes your mistake in front of a client.

solution_hint: Stamp each version and link it back.

metaphor.body: Each finished version gets a tick tied to it by a thread to the tick before; tug any old version and every later thread goes taut.

steps.picture: Each time the whale finishes a version, a tick is tied to the line, holding a thin thread to the tick before it.
steps.words: Stamp each version and link it back.

steps.picture: A new version is a new line with its own tick, linked to the last; the old line stays where it was.
Someone tugs an old line to change it in place; the thread to every later tick goes taut and glows copper; a flag rises.
steps.words: A silent change? Every later tick shows it.

steps.picture: The chain of ticks gets its name.
steps.words: A chain of stamps: the ledger.

real_case.claim: The Motion Atlas registry ledger holds 25 entries (counted 2026-10-17). It is append-only, and each entry carries the hash of the one before.

source.title: kh/registry/ledger.jsonl + How to register a design

honest_limit.picture: A smudged, wrong design is stamped and chained like any other; its tick glows fine.
honest_limit.words: A wrong design gets stamped just fine.

not_this.body: A stamp shows unchanged, not good.

ending_pattern.body: FELT framing returns: the two near-identical lines. The whale tugs one; its thread lights to the tick marked sent; the other stays dark; the pod quotes the lit one and answers ✓.
ending_pattern.callback: The two lines the whale could not tell apart in bar 1 now each answer to their own tick.

end_belief.body: Never edit in place. Make a version.
